761380101.text: Lady Nefer! What a coincidence, you've come at just the right time...

761380102.text: You've made up your mind, then?

761380103.text: Huh? Made up my mind...? Wh-what do you mean, could it be...?

761380104.text: I know you've always wanted to visit the Frostmoon Scions.

761380105.text: You hope to get acquainted with Lyylikki first, and use that friendship as your stepping stone.

761380106.text: You... you knew it all along? But I've kept it locked in my heart and barely told anyone...

761380107.text: Well, Mr. Zompaynco, when you guard a secret, you must also learn to hide the fact that you're guarding one.

761380108.text: Otherwise, no matter how tall a wall you build in your heart, sooner or later the wind will find its cracks.

761380109.text: *sigh* I was never good at keeping my feelings bottled up, even back when I was still in my hometown.

761380110.text: Well, now that you know, could you help me make an introduction? I'm an outsider, and I don't want to intrude on Miss Lyylikki.

761380111.text: Rest assured. The Frostmoon Scions are exceptionally gracious — whether one arrives as a stranger or in a form not entirely human, they will extend a warm and courteous welcome.

761380113.text: But still, it wouldn't be proper to just barge in. Lady Nefer, could you introduce me?

761380114.text: Alright. Judging by the time, they should have just finished distributing the meals — perfect timing for a chat. Let's go.

761380115.text: By the way, no charge this time. I was just passing by, anyway.

761380116.text: Oh, thank you so much! I'll go get my things right away.

subQuests.subQuestName: Accompany Zompaynco to speak with Lyylikki

761380201.text: Lady Nefer? And... Mr. Zompaynco. What brings you here?

761380202.text: Our Natlanese guest here has expressed interest in visiting the Frostmoon Scions.

761380203.text: But, out of courtesy, he'd prefer someone to introduce him. Well then, Mr. Zompaynco, the floor is yours.

761380204.text: G—Greetings, Miss Lyylikki! It's such a pleasure to meet you. Uh... I brought this fossil specimen from Natlan along...

761380205.text: Thank you, but Mr. Zompaynco... umm... We've already met, haven't we? You really don't need to be so formal.

761380206.text: Huh? Then... how did you notice me?

761380207.text: You've always been there when I was distributing meals, haven't you? Wandering around the line, circling back and forth, but never stepping in.

761380208.text: I thought you might want a serving but were too shy to say so, so I quietly set a portion aside for you.

761380209.text: But you've never came around to claim one. In fact, you hadn't shown up today, I was going to ask someone to check and see if you need help or something like that.

761380210.text: Ah... I—I'm so sorry. I've been hesitating, trying to figure out how to say hello...

761380211.text: So, Miss Lyylikki... would it be alright if I paid the Frostmoon Scions a visit?

761380212.text: Of course. We've welcomed a few guests from outside before. But may I ask why?

761380213.text: I'd like to take some photos and notes, look through some records, and if possible... ask someone about the local legends!

761380214.text: I'm a member of Natlan's Saurian Relics Association. If I could find materials connected to my research, that would be invaluable.

761380215.text: I see... so you're hoping to spend some time in the archives, then? Let me think...

761380216.text: Well, now that the two of you have been properly introduced, my task here is done. I'll take my leave.

761380217.text: Thank you, Lady Nefer! But... I really must pay you for your trouble — it would be wrong to have you make this trip for nothing.

761380219.text: Then I'll be off. Have yourself a pleasant conversation.
